footnote_text: Pursuant to the Securities Purchase Agreement, dated May 1, 2026, by and between the Registrant, Rantizo, Inc. and certain shareholders as named therein (the "SPA"), the Reporting Person sold 782,372 of its Class B Ordinary Shares to Rantizo, Inc. on October 9, 2026. || On March 30, 2026, the Registrant effected a 0-to-1 share consolidation of the Registrant's ordinary shares (the "Share Consolidation"). The number of ordinary shares reported on this Form 4 reflects the Reporting Person's Class B Ordinary Shares after giving effect to the Share Consolidation. || Pursuant to the SPA, Rantizo, Inc. paid $8,000,000 as consideration for an aggregate of 1,085,264 Class B Ordinary Shares.
